implemented: Browser favicon now wraps the existing unmodified 192px Nexus PNG in an ICO container. Studio/shared pages and native startup assets declare it; the public asset allowlist serves /favicon.ico with image/x-icon.
Wheel package-data includes ICO files; service-worker public shell cache advances to v60 and includes favicon. Existing install/touch icons stay unchanged.

Passive local Whisper readiness checks model, module spec and FFmpeg. Piper checks model, executable and adjacent .onnx.json. Display-only missing_prerequisites and verification_scope are additive public fields.

Voice picker lists missing prerequisites and rejects unavailable local selection before recording/submission. It preserves explicit selection and never auto-selects a separately billed API. API credentials are not checked by passive readiness.

public_http_recheck.scope: Two overlapping public HTTP checks rerun after incoming optional native-auth changes; not additional unique tests.

packaging.builder: setuptools.build_meta.build_wheel in temporary source staging; no installation, network or source build-directory changes.

validation.icon_decoder: macOS sips identifies the ICO as 192 by 192; existing PNG bytes are preserved exactly.
validation.static: Affected Python lint/format, JavaScript syntax and diff whitespace pass.

compatibility: No persisted records or queued profile/job formats change. model_ready now reflects known passive local prerequisites rather than a model file alone. Public metadata adds display labels without private paths. API availability is explicitly account-not-checked, not entitlement proof.
remaining: Actual installed local speech model loading and transcription/synthesis quality.
Explicitly configured API accounts, real microphones/playback, physical devices and personal HTTPS VM operation.
Separate native session, portable runtime, workspace ownership and installed OS gates; concurrent native work is not certified by this slice.
